name: Bioderma Atoderm Creme Ultra 500ml Ultra-Nourishing Moisturizing Cream For Normal To Dry Sensitive Skin
description:
Bioderma Atoderm Creme 500ml
Ultra Nourishing Moisturizing Cream | For Normal to Dry Sensitive Skin

Description:
Bioderma Atoderm Creme deeply and immediately moisturizes the skin, providing long-lasting hydration. From the very first application, it leaves skin soft, supple, and comfortable.

Key Features:

Ultra Nourishing: Provides intense hydration for normal to dry sensitive skin.

Gentle & Safe: Very good tolerance, non-comedogenic, and suitable for sensitive skin.

Smooth & Lightweight: Smooth texture with fast absorption for a non-greasy feel.

Fragrance-Free: Ideal for those with sensitive skin or fragrance allergies.

Experience soft, supple, and well-moisturized skin with Bioderma Atoderm Creme.

Made in France
